observations.plaza: The view moves out into the plaza at file 39s. The distant blue Citadel is visible behind the narrow foreground broadcast pylon at 42–50s. The view turns elsewhere at 51–53s and shows the Citadel again at 54–56s. It turns to the station doors around 60–62s and back toward the plaza around 63–65s.
observations.alley: Around file 110–116s the view turns from the square near Terminal Hotel into a narrower street. The subsequent samples show the near walls, doors and the next local route. Keep this as a later view within the same chapter.
observations.bounds: Describe visibility and camera orientation. The distant blue tower and foreground Breen broadcast pylon are distinct landmarks. The source does not show a controlled height change, prove a player intention, or measure the distance to the Citadel.
observations.guides: Outline the distant blue tower when its visible profile is in frame. End the outline on the turn away. Match any local-route guide to the actual street opening and keep the source text and caption area clear.

openingCueDraft.ko: 역을 나서면 광장 너머로 시타델이 보입니다. 주변을 둘러본 뒤 다시 같은 탑을 찾으면 지금 어느 쪽을 보고 있는지 비교할 기준이 생깁니다. 기준점이 중간에 가려졌다가 다시 보이는 경우를 살펴보겠습니다.
openingCueDraft.en: Outside the station, the Citadel rises beyond the square. Finding the same tower after looking around gives you a reference for which way you are facing. Let’s see what changes when that landmark disappears and comes back into view.
